title: Births as rich as the neighbours

thesis.claim: Asking a child to start with at least what its parent's neighbours hold keeps the healthy space the estates make and gives back the diversity they cost. With brains mixed at birth, parents as mates and the estate of the dead paid to births, and a child never poorer than the median holding of its parent's neighbours, both worlds of at least one of the two estates (to the newborns, to the parents), at iteration 3,000, meet every mark of the health bar, are more diverse than B2's median world, are at least 1.5 times as wide as their random twins, and are no more even than B2's least even world, B2's ten worlds played on being read at the same iteration.
thesis.why: In Experiment 31 the estates gave Experiment 19's world every mark and a space of about three dimensions, 2.0 to 2.65 times as wide as its twin. But they filled it with children: about 5,000 agents for 10,000 tokens, 1.9 tokens each, whose tokens fill about two doubling classes. The diversity scores fell to 0.32 to 0.41, and the tokens became a little more even than B2's (Ginis of 0.42 to 0.45). The estate makes a birth cheap, and nothing stops a world from making paupers. A child that must start as rich as the agents it is born among stops that, with no number of its own: the world can grow only as rich as it is. Experiment 31's estate worlds of the same seeds are the control, as is Experiment 19's world for the floor alone.
thesis.confirm: For at least one estate rule, both worlds (seeds 1 and 2) at 3,000 meet every mark, have a diversity score above the median of B2's ten worlds read at 3,000 (0.54), a typical distance at least 1.5 times their twin's, and a Gini no lower than the least of those ten worlds' (0.47).
thesis.refute: Neither estate rule has both its worlds pass all four at 3,000; the chapter says what the floor changed and what it did not.

conditions.name: estate to the newborns, a child as rich as its neighbours
estate to the parents, a child as rich as its neighbours
a child as rich as its neighbours
